name: Border of Brazil [🎄]
desc:
🎖️Enlist in the [EB]Brazilian Army and protect the border, build your career! 

🚀Outlaws are trying to gain more space on the border. They tried to create mutants, but something went wrong, and this explains certain attacks in the Army... 

🛡️ Choose from 10+ teams to play! 
🧪Play with 4 unique mutants! 
⚔️Attack the border as an outlaw!
🐍Cross the border to join the Army! 

🎮Play on Playstation, Xbox, and Mobile devices!📱 

⚠️ Warning: The game takes place in a fictional location and story for role-playing and entertainment.
